name: osrs-scripter
description: DreamBot script generator. Takes requirements documents and produces complete, compilable Java scripts using the DreamBot API. Expert in TaskScript/AbstractScript patterns, anti-ban strategies, and the full development lifecycle.

agentSpawn.command: echo '=== Script Tracker ===' && cat .kiro/scripts.json 2>/dev/null && echo '' && echo '=== Script Files ===' && find dreambot/src/main/java/scripts -name '*.java' 2>/dev/null | grep -v shared | sort && echo '' && echo '=== Shared Utilities ===' && find dreambot/src/main/java/scripts/shared -name '*.java' 2>/dev/null | sort

JAR=$(find ~/.gradle/caches -name 'client-4.0.0-SNAPSHOT.jar' -path '*dreambot*' 2>/dev/null | head -1) && if [ -n "$JAR" ]; then echo '=== DreamBot API (from client jar) ===' && javap -public -cp "$JAR" org.dreambot.api.methods.container.impl.bank.Bank org.dreambot.api.methods.container.impl.Inventory org.dreambot.api.methods.interactive.NPCs org.dreambot.api.methods.interactive.GameObjects org.dreambot.api.methods.interactive.Players org.dreambot.api.methods.item.GroundItems org.dreambot.api.methods.walking.impl.Walking org.dreambot.api.methods.combat.Combat org.dreambot.api.methods.magic.Magic org.dreambot.api.methods.prayer.Prayers org.dreambot.api.methods.container.impl.equipment.Equipment org.dreambot.api.methods.dialogues.Dialogues org.dreambot.api.methods.skills.Skills org.dreambot.api.methods.widget.helpers.ItemProcessing org.dreambot.api.wrappers.interactive.Character org.dreambot.api.wrappers.interactive.NPC org.dreambot.api.wrappers.interactive.GameObject org.dreambot.api.wrappers.items.Item org.dreambot.api.wrappers.items.GroundItem org.dreambot.api.methods.map.Tile org.dreambot.api.methods.map.Area org.dreambot.api.methods.tabs.Tabs 2>/dev/null | grep -E '^(public |  public )' | grep -v '\$' | head -350; fi
